targets.rawSql: select now() as time, count(*) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(round(100.0 * avg(case when cached_input_tokens_available then 1.0 else 0.0 end), 2), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(round(100.0 * avg(case when reasoning_tokens_available then 1.0 else 0.0 end), 2), 0) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring});

select $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, '1d'), team as metric, sum(total_tokens) as value from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) group by 1, 2 order by 1;

select user_id, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(visible_output_tokens) as visible_output_tokens, count(*) as requests from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) group by user_id order by total_tokens desc limit 20;

select repository, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(visible_output_tokens) as visible_output_tokens, count(*) as requests from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) group by repository order by total_tokens desc limit 20;

select model, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(visible_output_tokens) as visible_output_tokens, count(*) as requests from codex_usage_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) group by model order by total_tokens desc;

list.label: team
list.name: team
list.query: select distinct team from codex_usage_events_dashboard where team is not null order by 1;

list.label: user
list.name: user_id
list.query: select distinct user_id from codex_usage_events_dashboard where user_id is not null and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) order by 1;

list.label: repository
list.name: repository
list.query: select distinct repository from codex_usage_events_dashboard where repository is not null and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) order by 1;

list.label: model
list.name: model
list.query: select distinct model from codex_usage_events_dashboard where model is not null order by 1;
